==Enemies==
'''Lunar''' may refer to these event enemies:
*[[Lunar Servant]], a major boss that first appeared on Wave 19 in [[Totality Tower|Night IV]] of the [[Solar Eclipse Event]]
*[[Lunar Shield]], a high health enemy that first appeared on Wave 15 in [[Totality Tower|Night IV]] of the [[Solar Eclipse Event]]
*[[Lunar Shard (Legacy)]], a fast enemy that first appeared on Wave 7 in [[Totality Tower|Night IV]] of the [[Solar Eclipse Event]]
